_what_this_is: An ADVERSARIAL application of NCP v0.1 to Consullo's EXISTING checks. Every negative control below was EXECUTED against a deliberately broken build on 2026-08-10; the first version of this attestation derived its outcomes by reading source and disclosed that as a limitation. It is NON-CONFORMING, which is the result, not a defect in the attestation.

checks.certifies: the application is reachable on port 8080

negative_control.condition: the engine is dead but the process still holds the socket
negative_control.how_produced: a Python process bound 127.0.0.1:8080, accepted connections and served nothing at all -- AS-01's state, where the process is alive and holding the socket while the capability behind it is dead

run.method: EXECUTED against a deliberately broken build, not inferred from source

negative_control.how_produced: an HTTP server returning exactly what HealthServlet returns on component failure: HTTP 503 with body {"status": "unhealthy", ...}

run.note: printed 'Application is responsive' and exited 0 against a service that had just reported itself unhealthy
run.method: EXECUTED against a deliberately broken build, not inferred from source

run.note: STATUS=healthy, and components contained ONLY memory and system -- no database key of any kind. A consumer cannot distinguish 'database healthy' from 'database never checked'.
run.method: EXECUTED against a deliberately broken build, not inferred from source

negative_control.how_produced: -Dhealth.check.database.enabled=true -Ddev.mode=true with no database available, against the real getHealthStatus()

run.note: STATUS=healthy while components.database.status was 'unavailable'. The same run with -Ddev.mode=false returned STATUS=unhealthy, so development mode alone converts an unavailable database into an overall healthy verdict.
run.method: EXECUTED against a deliberately broken build, not inferred from source

negative_control.correction: The first version of this attestation said the response 'does not record that development mode is in force'. THAT WAS WRONG. Execution shows components.database.message reads 'Database not available in development mode'. The disclosure exists, inside the component message. The defect is narrower and still real: the TOP-LEVEL status says healthy, and every consumer that reads the status -- including HealthServlet's own choice of HTTP 200 vs 503, and responsiveness_check's grep -- sees healthy and never reaches the message.

checks.certifies: the engine can complete a SAMPLED (temperature > 0) request

negative_control.condition: the sampled-decode path is dead while the process still serves HTTP
negative_control.how_produced: the AS-01 failure, observed in production: a lazily-compiled kernel on the sampled path failed on first use and killed the executor

run.note: temperature 0.7 reaches _prepare_probs_with_temperature -> flashinfer softmax_op -> sampling_from_probs_op, which is the code that died. The canary source carries the reasoning inline. This is the ONE check here with a demonstrated failure mode -- and it has one because it was rebuilt AFTER the outage that its predecessor could not see.

unsupported: N5 relevance -- that a control perturbs the capability rather than the transport -- is a declared field a human must judge; nothing checks it.
undisclosed_nothing.note: The previous version listed every outcome as skipped, because they were derived by reading source. All four have now been executed and that entry is retired.

claim: Five checks of the Consullo enterprise layer were assessed against NCP v0.1, with every negative control EXECUTED against a deliberately broken build. FOUR survive their own negative controls and are therefore not evidence that anything works. One fails under its control and conforms. This is process evidence about the checks and is not a claim about the system.
